target_claim: The proof asserts the term-by-term identity sum_{p prime} ln(p) * p^{-z}/(1 - p^{-z}) = sum_{p prime} d/dz ln( -1 / (1 - p^{-z}) ). This equality is false: for each prime p the right-hand summand is the NEGATIVE of the left-hand summand, because the constant factor -1 does not change the derivative and d/dz ln(1/(1-p^{-z})) = -ln(p) p^{-z}/(1-p^{-z}).
